theorems.name: Submission.aal_height_of_net_plane
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (ξ x₀ : Amb n ℓ) (S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (F : Finset (Amb n ℓ)) (a b : ℝ), ‖x₀ - ξ‖ ≤ a → (∀ y ∈ F, ‖(x₀ - y) - T.starProjection (x₀ - y)‖ ≤ b) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ F, dist x y ≤ a) → ∀ x ∈ S, infDist (x - ξ) (T : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ b + 2 * a
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
